events.detail_full_zh: 受保守工程影响，截至12日的每日09:45左右至16:50左右，三原站至竹原站之间的列车将停运。届时将提供替代运输服务。
events.detail_full_en: Due to the effects of the maintenance work, services on the Mihara-Takehara section will be suspended from approximately 09:45 to 16:50 each day until the 12th. Substitute transportation will be provided.
